<!-- Included by report.qmd. Shares its params. Comparison of the new index with the previous
assessment's published index (config PREVIOUS_INDEX_FILE: csv or rds with year and est, in
index years). Both series are rescaled to their mean over the overlapping years, so the
comparison is of shape, not level. A revision larger than REVISION_TOLERANCE is a finding to
explain (new data, late vessels, filters, model change), not an error to tune away. -->

```{r, eval=params$include_bridging && !is.null(cfg$PREVIOUS_INDEX_FILE)}
#| label: fig-bridging-section-previous-index
#| fig-cap: "New and previous assessment index, each rescaled to its mean over the overlapping years. Points mark years whose relative change exceeds the revision tolerance."
#| output: asis
cat("## Comparison with the previous assessment index\n\n")
index_total <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "index-total.rds"))
previous_path <- here::here(cfg$PREVIOUS_INDEX_FILE)
previous <- if (grepl("\\.rds$", previous_path)) readRDS(previous_path) else
  utils::read.csv(previous_path)
bridge <- compare_with_previous(index_total, previous,
                                tolerance = cfg$REVISION_TOLERANCE %||% 0.2)
saveRDS(bridge, file.path(out_dir, "bridging.rds"))

bridge_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(bridge$table, c("new", "previous"),
                                   names_to = "series", values_to = "relative")
print(
  ggplot2::ggplot(bridge_long, ggplot2::aes(year, relative, colour = series)) +
    ggplot2::geom_line() +
    ggplot2::geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(bridge_long, flagged, series == "new"), size = 2) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Index year", y = "Index relative to overlap mean", colour = NULL)
)
cat("\nMedian absolute relative change:", sprintf("%.1f %%", 100 * bridge$median_abs_change),
    "\n\nTerminal overlapping year:", sprintf("%+.1f %%", 100 * bridge$terminal_change),
    "\n\nYears beyond the tolerance:",
    if (length(bridge$flagged_years)) paste(bridge$flagged_years, collapse = ", ") else "none",
    "\n")
```
